verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a payroll/PEO SaaS like Justworks, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents UI-driven workflows (side navigation, tabs, buttons) and a Xero integration. The help.justworks.com/api/v2 URLs are the help-center article search endpoint, not a product API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a product API at all, let alone UI parity.
